input.title: Unisex Pickle – Yes, I Drink the Juice. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

YES, I DRINK THE JUICE. is the pickle hoodie for the person who finishes the jar and then the brine, worn at the kitchen counter, at the farmers market and as a gift for the friend who keeps the pickle jar in the fridge door.

YES, I DRINK runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and THE JUICE. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a cartoon dill pickle with little arms and legs sits on the rim of a big glass pickle jar, sipping the brine through a striped straw with a satisfied face, with dill sprigs and garlic cloves around the jar.

Navy carries cream and pickle green lettering with a cream edge around the jar; Sand gets deep green and rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this pickle hoodie warm enough for cool kitchens and farmers market mornings?
Yes. The Yes, I Drink the Juice. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cool kitchens, farmers market mornings and long evenings at home.

How does the Yes, I Drink the Juice. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a pickle lover?
It is a natural one. Every pickle lover has been judged for sipping the brine, so it lands with canning fans, fridge-door snackers and the family that stopped asking. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the jar scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Yes, I Drink the Juice. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
